tasks.subject: Task 1: ServerDisplay helpers + DRY
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Create `serverLabel`/`currentChannelName` in `mumble/model` with JVM tests; route `buildCallScreenState` through `serverLabel`.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/model/ServerDisplay.kt`
- Test: `app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/model/ServerDisplayTest.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/ui/CallScreenState.kt`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `serverLabel(model, hostFallback)` = root-channel name, or hostFallback when blank/"Root"/no root.
- [ ] `currentChannelName(model)` = local user's channel name, or null if sessionId/user/channel missing.
- [ ] `buildCallScreenState` uses `serverLabel(...)`; existing CallScreenStateTest still passes.
- [ ] Both helpers' tests pass on JVM.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests "me.danielstiner.dumble.mumble.model.ServerDisplayTest" --tests "me.danielstiner.dumble.ui.CallScreenStateTest"` -> PASS.

**Steps:** TDD test -> ServerDisplay.kt -> DRY buildCallScreenState -> run -> commit. Full code in plan doc (Task 1).

tasks.subject: Task 2: Notification server/channel plumbing
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Post server label + channel on the FGS CallStyle notification, live-refreshed from `MumbleManager.model`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/telecom/CallNotificationManager.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/telecom/CallForegroundService.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/telecom/CallManager.kt`
- Modify: `app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/ActiveCallActivity.kt`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `createNotification(serverLabel, channelName, isIncoming, connectedSinceMs)`: Person = `serverLabel.ifBlank { "Dumble" }`; `setContentText("in <channel>")` ONLY when channelName != null.
- [ ] `CallForegroundService.start(ctx, serverLabel, channelName, connectedSinceMs)` via extras.
- [ ] `CallManager.startCall(host)` seeds host; model collector re-posts FGS on (serverLabel, channelName) change; `startCallForeground()` passes server/channel; `teardown()` resets state.
- [ ] `ActiveCallActivity.onConnect` calls `startCall(config.host)`.
- [ ] assembleDebug + full unit suite green.

**Verify:** `export JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" && ./gradlew assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, tests pass.

**Steps:** createNotification(server,channel) null-not-"" + blank guard -> FGS extras/start -> CallManager fields+startCall(host)+collector+startCallForeground+teardown reset -> ActiveCallActivity startCall(config.host) -> build+test -> commit. Full before/after in plan doc (Task 2).
